title: Type hierarchy
slide_intent: Teach designers to give a reader an entry point, an explanation and an action through a change in type role. Weight, scale and spacing make the order visible before the reader finishes the copy.
strategic_value: A large Agrandir headline can give Bolt’s short promise a distinctive voice while Inter gives longer explanations and controls a quieter texture.
demonstration: One pale specimen panel stacks a headline, subline, body paragraph, annotation and button. Each example has a small role label and typeface name. The headline and subline use Agrandir, and the remaining roles use Inter.
practical_value: Choose type roles for a message containing both a claim and an action. Compare the relative scale and spacing of the specimens before setting the copy.

content_islands.name: Section rail and guidance
content_islands.spec: Use the black rail and a white introduction column. Mark Typography in the rail and place the title above the short guidance.

content_islands.name: Headline and subline
content_islands.spec: Give the wide pale panel a common left margin. Label and set the largest Agrandir headline on one line, then place the smaller two-line subline below with its own label.

content_islands.name: Body and annotation
content_islands.spec: Set the Inter paragraph below the subline with a narrower measure. Leave space before the small annotation and its one-line example.

content_islands.name: Action specimen
content_islands.spec: End the sequence with a labeled dark checkout button aligned to the same left edge.
